groups.activity: rank up with the Entrati to Associate (Rank 3)
conditions: Old Peace (Update 41, Dec 2025) rebalanced this rank sacrifice: guides naming Medjay Predasite or common bird tags instead of Sly Vulpaphyla/Vizier Predasite tags are pre-rework and wrong.
Sly Vulpaphyla and Vizier Predasite tags come from Conservation on Deimos, not combat kills.

groups.activity: trade resource tokens up to Grandmother Tokens
groups.meta: 10 Grandmother Tokens buys the single Seriglass Shard

rows.label: Grandmother Token
rows.note: trades for the single Seriglass Shard

conditions: Grandmother's 'Mend the Family' trade offers cycle every 8 hours and are randomised: you can't grind them on demand.
Since Old Peace (Dec 2025), Daughter/Father/Otak tokens are worth 500 standing each, Son 1,000, Grandmother 3,000; a Grandmother Token is always worth 50% more than what's paid for it.
Seriglass Shard costs 10 Grandmother Tokens, down from 20 pre-Old-Peace: threads describing a 20-token cost are stale.
bonuses: Trade spare Mother Tokens up to Grandmother Tokens on every Deimos trip rather than running a dedicated session; several players report never having 'farmed' the shard at all this way.

disclosures.title: this is the real currency grind
disclosures.body: Seriglass Shard is the single line item people call out as the actual Trumna bottleneck: it's invisible until the parts blueprints are bought, so start banking tokens the same day mining starts, not after the 12-hour parts finish.

conditions: A spare Barrel blueprint is also a required sacrifice for Necraloid Rank 3 (Clearance: Odima); buy and build a second while at Father if you care about that syndicate too.

rows.label: Trumna Stock
rows.note: 20,000 cr, 45 Auroxium Alloy, 30 Lucent Teroglobe, 20 Saturated Muscle Mass, 2 Cabochon Embolos

rows.label: Trumna
rows.note: 1 Seriglass Shard + the three parts above

conditions: Trumna ships with zero polarities and a 5-second reload; budget 3+ Forma before judging it.

disclosures.title: the grind is worth it
disclosures.body: Community sentiment is close to unanimous that the gun is worth the grind, unlike Caliban or the Hema. The recurring regret is buying a Trumna riven before realizing the weapon itself can't be bought with plat at all.
